plans.idea: Faithful centered poster stack: logo crown, large bottle, then the 30% OFF text block, with the CTA and the SUMMER ONLY badge side by side on one row as in the original, and legal anchored at the foot.
Offer first: a big headline block right under the logo, the SUMMER ONLY badge pinned to the bottle's top-right so it reads as a product tag, then one wide centered CTA above the legal line.
Header bar of logo on the left and badge on the right, a full-width product image filling the upper half, then a full-width text block and a broad CTA, read straight down a strong vertical axis.
